detail: Second, independent 1.x field bug (13:50 and 03:44 logs on 2026-08-04): the recovery block set PATH="$LOGIN_PATH", discarding the inherited PATH. sh -lc reads ~/.profile, not ~/.zshrc, so dirs only the interactive rc adds (the field machine's ~/.local/bin node shims) never appear in the login PATH. When Claude Code spawned with a clean minimal environment, recovery yielded a node-less PATH → rung 5 "Node.js was not found on PATH" exit 127. Intermittency explained: when the inherited PATH was already good (cmux), ~/.profile's $PATH passthrough preserved node. Fix in plugin 1.24.1: merge login PATH ahead of inherited PATH (never replace), then if node is still unresolvable append existing well-known install dirs ($HOME/.local/bin, /opt/homebrew/bin, /usr/local/bin, volta/asdf/mise shims; nvm/fnm deliberately excluded — per-version dirs with no stable bin path). TWINING_LAUNCH_RECOVERY_DIRS (colon list) is the test seam; TWINING_LAUNCH_NO_LOGIN_PATH now skips ALL recovery including dir probing. SessionStart hook needs no change — it shells launch-server.sh --probe and shares recovery.
summary: launch-server.sh login-PATH recovery replaced PATH instead of merging — node reachable only via interactive-rc dirs (~/.local/bin from .zshrc) was lost, causing intermittent exit 127 in the field
